clean_repro.probe: Create collection, insert 2 rows, load collection, call get_stats
clean_repro.observed: Insert succeeded (2 rows inserted), but get_stats returned rowCount=0. API reports zero row count despite successful insert.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/create" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "verify_rowcount", "dimension": 4}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/insert" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "verify_rowcount", "data": [{"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, {"id": 2, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}]}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/load" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "verify_rowcount", "dbName": "default"}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/get_stats" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "verify_rowcount"}'

contract_refs: Endpoint: collections+get_stats - Get row count and other statistics for a collection
Expected behavior: rowCount should reflect actual number of entities in collection

source_grounding.source_excerpt: // collections+get_stats should return accurate row count from metadata. The discrepancy suggests either stats not updated after insert or stats cache issue.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 handler_v2.go:getStats() → proxy.GetCollectionStats() → should return rowCount from collection metadata
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:get_stats 返回的 rowCount 与实际插入行数不一致。这是一个真实的数据一致性问题,可能是统计信息未及时更新或缓存问题。

verdicts.rationale: get_stats API 返回的 rowCount (0) 与实际插入行数 (2) 不一致,是真实的数据一致性问题。Query 操作证实数据确实存在于集合中,排除假阴性可能。此问题影响统计信息准确性,属于状态一致性违规。可能根因包括:统计信息未在 insert 后及时更新、统计缓存失效、或元数据同步延迟。这不属于预期行为,而是需要修复的缺陷。
